owner: W1-10, from RI-WPN01 §D and RI-WPN04 §B. This file exists because moveset.schema.json's `trigger` block is {button, modifier, state_window} with additionalProperties:false and therefore CANNOT express a chord (two buttons held together) or a conjunction of state predicates. Rather than encode a half-truth in the slot and leave the rest in code, the full conjunction for every slot is written down here, machine-readable, so a critic can build the input script for any slot without reading a line of JavaScript.
buffer_note: The combo buffer is 8 f@60 (133 ms) and holds exactly ONE action. S22 does not rebase it (RI-CMB01 §C.6). A press within 8 f BEFORE a window opens is buffered and fires on the window's first frame; a press earlier than that is DROPPED, not stored; a press after a window closes produces the standard r1.1 once the state ends, and that is the ONLY legal path from a contextual state to the standard attack.

also_requires: forward move magnitude < 0.9 OR a light press in the last 8 f@60 (otherwise this is guardbreak)
inside the 8 f@60 buffer or the recovery window
class chain length >= 4 (DGR, CSW, FST and weapons with a chain delta)

r2.charged.note: Hold inserts charge_max_f frames between startup and active. Release fires; over-holding fires at full charge; nothing cancels it (RI-WPN01 §C.2).

also_requires: or within the 8 f@60 grace after sprint release
vel_y < 0 (descending) — there are no rising jump attacks
fall height >= 3.0 m above the last grounded frame
a valid target inside a 2.0 m radius cylinder below
plunge.note: Takes precedence over jump.r1/jump.r2 when both are legal.

guard.counter.collision: RI-CMB02 §C states this window as 24 f@60 while RI-WPN01 §A, RI-WPN04 §B and RI-WPN06 §E all state 40 f@60. The collision is pre-existing and flagged, not resolved (REBASE-S22-REPORT §7). This build implements 40 and says so.

also_requires: NO light press in the previous 8 f@60
guardbreak.note: The Souls kick. No new button; the input is deliberately awkward, exactly as upstream. It is the only contextual slot reachable from idle.

art.1.note: The schema cannot express a chord. The declared trigger names the distinguishing half; this row is the whole of it.

2h.*.note: Two-handing is a stance, entered by TAPPING two_hand: a 36 f@60 uncancellable animation, legal only from IDLE / WALK / RUN. It selects a different slot table, not a multiplier.

bow.aimed.note: charge_max_f 90; enters a shoulder cam (RI-CAM04 owns the camera).

harness_scripts.note: Ready-made queueInputs bodies for the four contextual slots RI-WPN01 M2 and RI-WPN04 M1 drive, at the LIGHT equip-load tier. Frames are relative to the queueInputs call (HARNESS.md §4).
